content:
vuln-bot: [ALERT] CVE-2026-1422 - libyaml: reported memory corruption in yaml_parser. Affects v0.2.5 and earlier. Scanner flagged artifacts in pkg-builder feed.
elaine: tagging — looks like pkg-builder vendors libyaml but it is only used at build-time in our CI test harness, not in runtime images.
morgan: confirm; staged runtime images don't include libyaml, only the builder container does. :thinking:
raj: I dug into the SBOM: vendor/libyaml@v0.2.5 is present in the builder image used by CI. Scanner treats all artifacts equally.
elaine: proposal: temporary exception for the artifact scanner on pkg-builder artifacts until we can rebuild the builder image with patched libyaml. Compensating controls: require artifact signing (KMS), restrict external pulls, and increase audit retention.
morgan: +1. What's the realistic timeline to rebuild and push images?
elaine: target 48 hours to update the builder image and run the full pipeline; fallback window 7 days if we hit infra blockers.
raj: security wants explicit compensating controls: (1) artifact signing enforced with KMS-wrapped keys, (2) RBAC so only CI service account can pull builder images, (3) audit logs for pulls forwarded to SIEM and retained 90d.
compliance-ops: we'll need a documented risk acceptance record with owner and expiration date before we approve.
elaine: created ticket SEC-2026-78 with plan, owner, and timeline: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SEC-2026-78 -- linking here for traceability.
morgan: example scanner policy we can apply temporarily (apply to artifact-registry):
```
# Temporary policy: block external pulls for pkg-builder
resource "artifact_policy" "pkg_builder_temp_block" {
  name             = "pkg-builder-temp-block-external"
  allow_external   = false
  applies_to       = ["pkg-builder/*"]
  expires_at       = "2026-03-22T00:00:00Z"
}
```
raj: also adding a runtime RBAC patch: CI service account only, no human tokens allowed to pull builder images. I'll send the PR to infra.
elaine: security approval conditions: artifact signing enforced via KMS key AES-9876 (key rotation checked), RBAC restriction applied, audit retention set to 90d, and SEC-2026-78 created with owner @morgan. If all met, exception granted until 2026-03-22. :white_check_mark:
compliance-ops: acknowledged. I'll add the acceptance note to the compliance tracker and notify privacy.
morgan: starting the rebuild now; will attach logs to the JIRA and ping here when images are published. :rocket:
raj: monitoring SIEM for any unexpected pulls; will revoke exception early if anomalous behavior observed. :eyes:
vuln-bot: exception recorded: CVE-2026-1422 | pkg-builder | expires 2026-03-22 | approver: elaine
elaine: thanks everyone — closing loop. Reopen thread if anything unexpected shows up. :wave:
